🔥 शाहरुख खान की King को लेकर आई है सबसे बड़ी खबर! 🎬

अमेरिकन मूवी टिकट वेबसाइट Fandango के मुताबिक, Shah Rukh Khan की आने वाली फिल्म King का रनटाइम 3 घंटे और 17 minutes हो सकता है। 🍿

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, सिद्धार्थ आनंद के निर्देशन में बनने वाली यह फिल्म 20 सालों में Shah Rukh Khan की पहली ऐसी फिल्म बन सकती है जो 3 घंटे का आंकड़ा पार करेगी। ⏰

इससे पहले 2006 में Karan Johar की फिल्म Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna 3 घंटे से लंबी थी। 🎥

Animal और Pushpa 2 जैसी लंबी फिल्मों की बॉक्स ऑफिस सफलता के बाद, makers का मानना है कि लंबी फिल्मों से cast, action sequences और emotions के साथ पूरा इंसाफ किया जा सकता है। 🌟

हालांकि यह देखना बाकी है कि Central Board of Film Certification यानी CBFC से पास होने के बाद यही रनटाइम रहता है या नहीं, और यह फिल्म 24 December 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी। 🎫

क्या आप सिनेमाघरों में 3 घंटे से लंबी फिल्म देखना पसंद करेंगे? 💬👇

ctx.text:
The excitement surrounding Shah Rukh Khan’s King is increasing with each passing day. Earlier this week, there were rumours that the much-awaited action entertainer would have a runtime of 2 hours and 35 minutes. However, as per the popular American movie ticketing website Fandango, the Siddharth Anand directorial has been listed with a runtime of 3 hours and 17 minutes. If this duration is indeed final, King will become Shah Rukh Khan’s first major film in 20 years to cross the three-hour mark. The last time the superstar had a release of over three hours was Karan Johar’s Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna (2006).
Interestingly, there was a time when Shah Rukh Khan regularly featured in films that ran for more than three hours. Between 2000 and 2006, several of his most memorable films, including Mohabbatein (2000), Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham (2001), Devdas (2002), Kal Ho Naa Ho (2003), Veer-Zaara (2004) and Swades (2004), had lengthy runtimes. Mohabbatein , at 3 hours and 35 minutes, ranks among the longest films of his illustrious career.
However, with changing times, filmmakers increasingly began to believe that audiences preferred shorter and crisper films. Interestingly, even Shah Rukh Khan’s Jab Tak Hai Jaan (2012) and Happy New Year (2014) fell just short of the three-hour mark. His more recent blockbusters, Pathaan (2023) and Jawan (2023), had runtimes of 2 hours and 26 minutes and 2 hours and 49 minutes, respectively.
But life seems to have come full circle. The phenomenal box office success of lengthy films like Animal, Pushpa 2 and Dhurandhar has challenged the perception that modern-day audiences have shorter attention spans. In that sense, it makes perfect sense for a big-ticket entertainer like King to have a runtime of over three hours if the narrative demands it. A longer runtime also gives the makers ample scope to do justice to the film’s ensemble cast, action sequences and emotional quotient.
It now remains to be seen whether the runtime listed on Fandango is retained when King is certified by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC). The film is scheduled to release in cinemas on December 24, 2026.
